identification: Handmade folk-art robot ('Mechanic Man'): Mobilgas petrol can for Turner Four-Stroke Rotary Mower as body, Mobil brake fluid tin head, spanner arm, brass legs; maker unknown

entries.note: Plain vintage Mobilgas petrol can for Turner Four-Stroke Rotary Mower, 1 gallon tin only (the can that forms the body); not a robot

searches_tried: | chrome: eBay AU sold 'robot made from oil cans tins folk art sculpture' (none), 'mobilgas petrol can turner mower' (1 exact can match; others were BP Victa cans), 'robot sculpture recycled metal oil can' (none). No sold robot sculpture comps found.
viewing_check: Look for a maker signature or tag, check welds/joins are solid, the can's condition and that the brass legs are stable. Value is as a decorative piece, with the can itself worth about A$40.
